name: 技术风格
description: 源自 rico-md 的「技术风格」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 10px 20px 20px 20px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; color: #2c3e50; background-color: #fff; word-wrap: break-word">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.3; margin: 36px 0 24px; padding: 0 0 12px; border-bottom: 3px solid {{accent}}">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.3; margin: 32px 0 20px; padding-left: 16px; padding-top: 4px; padding-bottom: 4px; border-left: 5px solid #00a67d; background: linear-gradient(to right, #f0f9ff 0%, transparent 100%)">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #2c3e50; line-height: 1.4; margin: 28px 0 18px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 3px solid #00a67d">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background-color: {{surface}}; color: #fff; padding: 12px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #f0f0f0; font-weight: 600">{{content}}</th>

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

divider.html: <hr style="margin: 36px 0; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, {{accent}}, transparent)">
